import re

# Select this year's electricity TXT bills
year = datetime.now().year
pattern_year_month = re.compile(r'/electricity/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$')

# Filter txt for current year
year_txt = []
for p in electricity_entries:
    m = pattern_year_month.search(p)
    if m and int(m.group(1))==year and m.group(3)=='txt':
        year_txt.append((int(m.group(2)), p))

year_txt_sorted = [p for mo,p in sorted(year_txt)]
print('year:', year)
print('electricity txt count:', len(year_txt_sorted))
print('files:', year_txt_sorted)

amounts = []
for p in year_txt_sorted:
    f = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    content = f['content']
    # Extract Total Amount => $X or Total Amount => X
    m = re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content)
    if not m:
        print('NO TOTAL AMOUNT found in', p)
    amt = float(m.group(1))
    amounts.append((p, amt))
    print(p, 'amount:', amt)

total = sum(amt for _, amt in amounts)
print('total:', total)
print('amounts:', amounts)

# Compute total electricity bills for current year from available txt bills
import re
from datetime import datetime

year = datetime.now().year
entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/electricity/', recursive=True, entry_type='all')

pattern = re.compile(r'/electricity/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.txt$')
year_txt_paths=[]
for p in entries:
    m=pattern.search(p)
    if m and int(m.group(1))==year:
        year_txt_paths.append((int(m.group(2)), p))

year_txt_paths_sorted=[p for mo,p in sorted(year_txt_paths)]

amounts=[]
for p in year_txt_paths_sorted:
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    content=f['content']
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError('No Total Amount found in '+p)
    amounts.append(float(m.group(1)))

total=sum(amounts)
print('year:', year)
print('txt files used:', year_txt_paths_sorted)
print('amounts:', amounts)
print('total:', total)

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=total)
